tierReason: Joining by invite changes who can access a project and adds invite schema and new public endpoints

findings.text: apps/api/src/invites/routes.ts join (~L467-487): invite looked up by codeHash only; inside the tx already_member and project_full are checked before the pending check, so a used/revoked/expired code returns 409 already_member or project_full instead of 404 invalid_invite, revealing the code once existed (breaks R15). Fix: after lockProject re-read the invite and throw invalid_invite unless pending, then the other checks; add tests (used/revoked code by existing member; used code on a full project).

apps/mobile/src/members/useMembers.ts + projects/[id]/members.tsx: on a 404 not_found useMembers sets members null with status ready, and the screen shows an endless ActivityIndicator for a removed person (no no-permission state; R33). Fix: on not_found refresh the projects so the existing leave-redirect sends them to the list, or show a 'no longer in this project' state with a way back.

apps/api/src/invites/schema.test.ts (~L92-106): no test checks AC26. The test inserts an invite after all migrations; it never applies the invites migration to a database that already has projects and members. Fix: apply migrations up to 20261111032020_projects, seed, apply 20261112023324_invites, compare rows; otherwise record AC26 as verified by inspection in the Test Handoff.

apps/api/src/invites/routes.ts create/list/revoke: requireOwner runs before lockProject, so an Owner demoted at the same moment can still create one invite. Re-check the caller's role inside the tx after lockProject, as members change() does.
apps/api/src/invites/routes.ts create (~L383): a codeHash collision (about 1 in 31^8) hits the unique constraint and returns 500; retry with a fresh code on a unique violation.

apps/mobile/.../projects/[id]/members.tsx (~L329-346): the action sheet opens from a per-row '…' button, while the R29 navigation map says 'tapping a member'. Confirm in QA or make the whole row pressable.

apps/api/src/members/routes.ts (~L667-669): removing yourself returns 400 validation_failed without the field details the ZodError path adds; a dedicated code such as use_leave would be clearer for clients.

apps/mobile/src/members/MembersAvatarRow.tsx (OVERLAP -11, GAP 6, minHeight 44) and src/ui/Avatar.tsx (34, 2) hard-code sizes; DESIGN.md says to use tokens. minHeight 44 could use layout.controlHeight.

apps/mobile/src/projects/syncCycle.ts (~L79-84): refresh() drops queued project writes after listProjects resolves without re-checking the generation; if A signs out and B signs in while A's slow listProjects is pending, B's queued offline edits for projects not in A's list are silently dropped. Fix: return if gen changed right after listProjects resolves (and optionally confirm queue owner), with a syncCycle test that changes the generation while listProjects is pending.

apps/mobile/src/projects/syncCycle.ts (~L79): projectsToDrop uses the server list after .filter(isProject), so one malformed item would drop that project's queued writes as if access were lost. Build the id set from the raw response (any item with a string id).

apps/api/src/invites/page-routes.ts and invites/routes.ts: page and join limits are per IP, and until TRUST_PROXY is set behind Render every request shares the proxy IP, so one scanner could block everyone. Add invites to the existing TRUST_PROXY note in docs/deploy.md.

apps/mobile/src/app/(app)/(home)/projects/join.tsx (~L40-43): after a successful join the screen relies on refresh() to bring the project in; if that refresh fails (network drops right after), projectView returns leave and the person lands on the Project list with no project and no message, and retrying gives already_member. Fix: commit the joined project (GET /projects shape) into the local list before navigating, or show a notice.

apps/mobile/src/app/(app)/(home)/projects/[id]/members.tsx (~L200-201): after a successful leave, refreshProjects().catch(()=>{}) then goToList(); if the refresh fails the left project stays in the list (R29 says it is gone) and tapping it gives 404s. Fix: remove the project from the local list and cache right after the 204.

apps/api/src/projects/routes.ts PATCH (~L147) and DELETE (~L168): requireOwner runs once without the project lock; now that roles can change, an Owner demoted at the same moment can still delete or edit the project. Re-check the Owner under lockProject as invite create/revoke now do.

apps/api/src/invites/routes.ts create/revoke: the 20 cap counts only pending invites and old rows are never cleaned, so an Owner (or a script with their session) can loop create/revoke and grow the table without bound; the pending count scans every row. Add a per-account/per-project create limit or a cleanup later.

apps/api/src/app.ts (~L39): the invite hash key derives from INTERNAL_SECRET, so rotating it after a leak voids pending invites, and a leaked secret plus a DB dump allows offline guessing of the 39-bit code space. Stated trade-off in docs/deploy.md; optional separate INVITE_CODE_KEY.

apps/mobile/src/auth/profile-store.ts and members/memberCache.ts: email and display name are now stored unencrypted in AsyncStorage (cleared on sign-out, owner-checked). Not verified that members.cache.v1 is pruned when a refresh drops a project the person was removed from; old co-member names may stay until sign-out.
